run-pairs.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,os,time,hashlib,statistics
base=Path.cwd();task=base/'.local/tool-tasks/smart-branch-cost-bound-20261006'
host=base/'.local/tool-tasks/intrinsic-card-value-20261006/updated-harness/OfflineSearchHarness.dll'
artifacts={'A':base/'.local/tool-tasks/upstream-pr213-sync-20261006/build/CombatSolver.dll','C':task/'build/CombatSolver.dll'}
roots=Path('/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests')
records=[]
for scene in ['dev-00-ironclad-elite','dev-10-ironclad-monster']:
 for label in ['A1','C1','C2','A2']:
  out=task/'performance'/scene/label;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dll=artifacts[label[0]]
  request=roots/(scene+'.json')
  cmd=['dotnet',str(host),'--request',str(request),'--label','smart-branch-cost-'+scene+'-'+label,'--out',str(out),'--profile','VeryHigh','--dop','16','--budget-ms','300000','--search-mode','Coordinator','--nodes','500000','--beam','135','--card-branches','72','--pile-branches','42','--hand-branches','54','--enable-no-gc-region','--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes','16','--use-portfolio','--production-budget']
  env=os.environ.copy();env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL']=str(dll)
  for key in ['DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled','COMPlus_PerfMapEnabled']:env.pop(key,None)
  plan={'scene':scene,'label':label,'command':cmd,'outerTimeoutSeconds':120,'dllSha256':hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'requestSha256':hashlib.sha256(request.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'noProfilerOrCorrectnessInstrumentation':True}
  (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
  start=time.monotonic()
  with (out/'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
   proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   try:code=proc.wait(timeout=120);status='Completed' if code==0 else 'Failed'
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait();code=proc.returncode;status='TimeoutNoRetry'
  record={'scene':scene,'label':label,'status':status,'exitCode':code,'launcherWallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,'path':str(out/'result.json'),'plan':plan}
  if status=='Completed':
   r=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text());record.update({k:r[k] for k in ['wallSeconds','peakProcessWorkingSetBytes','comparisonQuality','budget','solverMetrics','pruneCounters','timeBoundaryObserved']})
   record['rootStampSha256']=hashlib.sha256(r['rootContinuationStamp'].encode()).hexdigest()
   record['policy']=json.loads((out/'search-policy.json').read_text())
   record['resultSha256']=hashlib.sha256((out/'result.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
   cost=[]
   for logfile in (out/'logs').rglob('process.jsonl'):
    import re
    for line in logfile.read_text().splitlines():
     message=json.loads(line)['Message']
     m=re.search(r'SMART_POTION_ELIGIBILITY_BOUND ceiling=(-?\d+) pruned=(\d+)(?: cost_pruned=(\d+))?',message)
     if m:cost.append({'ceiling':int(m[1]),'pruned':int(m[2]),'newCostPruned':int(m[3] or 0)})
   record['smartBoundMembers']=cost
  records.append(record);(task/'performance-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({k:record.get(k) for k in ['scene','label','status','wallSeconds','peakProcessWorkingSetBytes','comparisonQuality']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
  if status!='Completed':raise SystemExit('Terminal failed/timeout sample preserved; paired plan stopped without retry')
